snippet.title: Foodgitives — First Gameplay Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504720/Foodgitives/

Foodgitives is a 1–4 player couch co-op arcade game where you and your gang sabotage the restaurants trying to cook you alive. Tilt levels, dodge deadly utensils, and roll for your life to the soundtrack of 1930s swing and big band jazz!

In singleplayer, you tilt the kitchen surface with one stick and roll your foodgitive with the other. In Co-Op, one player tilts while the others roll and dodge the chaos to survive — the tilter can save you—or doom you — communicate and cooperate, or blame each other when someone undoubtedly rolls off the edge.

Beat levels to unlock hard mode with its own leaderboards. Complete challenges to unlock new food characters. Replay levels with your unlocked crew to compete on the leaderboards and prove you're the ultimate foodgitive!
